ai_behavior.ally_safety_preference: Avoid descriptive choices likely to endanger allies when a safer source-backed option is apparent; no target-scoring rule is defined.
ai_behavior.area_pressure_preference: Consider area-oriented displayed records against meaningfully grouped opponents only after later execution authority supplies legal targets and geometry.
capability_dependencies: typed Burn and Fire Terrain where applicable
ai_behavior.defensive_response_preference: Prefer source-backed displayed defensive responses when threatened, but do not invent reaction timing or prevention values.
ai_behavior.fallback_behavior: When an option lacks typed legality, choose no invented mechanic; use ordinary GM adjudication outside the automated combat runtime or wait for combat compilation.
preferred_patterns: Use displayed Fire pressure options deliberately rather than indiscriminately.
Preserve defensive options when the character is under meaningful pressure.
Consider displayed area-pressure options when multiple opponents are meaningfully grouped, subject to later typed legality.
Use repositioning-oriented displayed features to avoid remaining exposed when appropriate.
prohibited_invented_mechanic_behavior: Do not invent damage, range, target, save, duration, condition, movement, reaction, zone, or resource values.
Do not submit ActionIntent or register this profile as a controller policy.
ai_behavior.resource_conservation_preference: Avoid spending all available Qi early unless the GM judges escalation necessary; no numeric reserve or execution rule is defined.

composite_playbooks.fallback_note: When the grouping is not appropriate, use another source-backed displayed feature; legality remains unresolved until combat typing.
composite_playbooks.grouping_note: Treat these as a tactical grouping, not a guaranteed sequence or proof that their mechanics combine.
composite_playbooks.resource_awareness_note: Check the Character Sheet and later typed execution definitions before spending Qi or resolving effects.
composite_playbooks.tactical_goal: Help the GM identify the character’s selected single-target Fire-oriented options.

composite_playbooks.fallback_note: If a displayed option lacks legal typed execution, do not resolve it as a combat action.
composite_playbooks.grouping_note: These records are grouped by displayed defensive or repositioning themes; no action economy, trigger, or sequence is asserted.
composite_playbooks.resource_awareness_note: Preserve Qi for source-backed defensive choices when appropriate, subject to later executable definitions.
composite_playbooks.tactical_goal: Help the GM locate defensive and movement-oriented selections.

composite_playbooks.fallback_note: Avoid invented zones, conditions, or targets when typed execution is unavailable.
composite_playbooks.grouping_note: This is a thematic grouping only. It does not define area geometry, targets, damage, Burn, Fire Terrain, or a legal sequence.
composite_playbooks.resource_awareness_note: Use later combat-readiness diagnostics before resolving any area, state, or terrain effect.
composite_playbooks.tactical_goal: Help the GM identify selected records whose authenticated display text suggests area or controlled-flame pressure.

dao.core_theme: Power becomes reliable through discipline, controlled escalation, and deliberate refinement rather than uncontrolled destruction.
dao.gm_usage_notes: Use as interpretive guidance for portrayal and descriptive framing only.
principles: Prefer deliberate application over indiscriminate release
risks: Confidence in control may obscure changing conditions
dao.roleplay_expression: Treat cultivation as a practice of making volatile power dependable without erasing its intensity.
strengths: Willingness to restrain force until it can be used deliberately
dao.tactical_expression: GM guidance: frame choices around measured escalation, resource awareness, and control of displayed Fire options. This grants no bonus or legal action.

i_ching.core_theme: Clarity, dependence, illumination, and sustained fire shaped through proper attachment and attention.
i_ching.gm_usage_notes: Use for theme and portrayal; do not infer mechanics from the hexagram.
i_ching.roleplay_expression: Explore how fire persists by clinging to fuel, purpose, relationships, and disciplined attention.
strengths: Ability to sustain a chosen direction
i_ching.tactical_expression: GM guidance: emphasize awareness, sustained attention, and controlled use of displayed Fire selections. This creates no check modifier or effect.
